svg.title: Billable time: client rates on logged hours — SoftTrack web design mockup (#299)
svg.desc: Time logged on a ticket is minutes, a day and a note, and a team that charges somebody for its time prices the hours in a spreadsheet. Billable is a switch on a worklog that the team sets; rates are finance’s, with an effective date, for a person, an epic or a customer; and amounts are shown to finance admins only.
svg.text: Billable time: client rates on logged hours
· hours, priced where only finance can see
